name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response relates to the context and preceding conversation. A relevant response should naturally continue the dialogue.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the response. The response should make sense within the context of the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how engaging the response is, including the use of open-ended questions or interesting facts that encourage further dialogue.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response. Creative responses should offer unique perspectives or ideas.

name: Emotion
description: Assesses the emotional tone conveyed in the response. An effective response should appropriately reflect or enhance the emotional context of the conversation.
